# Offline Is Not Broken

Version 2.5.0 tells you when a webcam is switched off on SkylineWebcams, closes a gap in the stream proxy, and keeps the integration in step with Home Assistant's own libraries.

## When a webcam is offline

- **The card says so.** SkylineWebcams switches webcams off now and then, and their page keeps answering with a still picture. The card used to show that picture with its printed "LIVE" badge, as if the stream had stalled. It now dims the picture and shows "Webcam offline", and starts playing by itself once the webcam broadcasts again. _[#20]_
- **An Online sensor for automations.** A webcam added through the UI gets an **Online** binary sensor on its device: on while it broadcasts, off while it is offline. You can use it to be told when your favourite view is back. Every camera, including those from YAML, also carries an `offline` attribute. _[#20]_
- **Fewer requests while offline.** An offline webcam is looked at again every 15 minutes instead of on every play attempt. _[#20]_

## Security

- **The stream proxy needs a secret key now.** The card plays each webcam through a small proxy inside Home Assistant. Until now that proxy opened a camera for anyone who knew its entry ID, and that ID is no secret: it is in the name of the diagnostics file and in the address of the integration's page. Each camera now gets a random key instead, new with every restart, which only signed-in users can read. The card picks it up by itself. _[#19]_

## Fixes

- **The same beautifulsoup4 as Home Assistant.** The integration asked for a newer version of the beautifulsoup4 library than the one Home Assistant ships for its own integrations, so Home Assistant could try to replace that library when it starts. The integration now asks for the version Home Assistant already has. _[#17]_

## If you already use the integration

Nothing to change. If a camera stays black right after the update, reload the browser once so it loads the new card. The Online sensors appear by themselves for webcams added through the UI.
